Your site now supports:
- an Add to cart button on product cards and product detail pages
- a cart drawer that shows all selected products
- one consolidated receipt for the entire order
- delivery charged once per order, only when items are in the cart

- [index.html](index.html)
- [product.html](product.html)
- [buy.html](buy.html)
- [script.js](script.js)
- [style.css](style.css)

- Click “Add to cart” on any product.
- Open the cart from the nav bar.
- On checkout, the receipt shows all items together and applies delivery once.
- The existing order form submission flow is still used for placement.

### Verification
I verified the implementation with:
- no editor errors reported for the updated files
- a successful local preview response from http://127.0.0.1:8000/index.html

You can open the site at http://127.0.0.1:8000/index.html to try it.
